findings.findingDescription: Leaky abstraction: Endpoint returns internal database entity [Task] without DTO encapsulation
causalTrace: 1. Controller method returns or accepts raw database @Entity instead of decoupled DTO.
2. Internal schema columns, audit fields, and relationship graphs are exposed over HTTP.
3. API clients bind to internal database representations, creating tight coupling.
4. Callers can exploit over-posting / mass-assignment by modifying internal entity fields.
findings.groundTruthEvidence: Task is an annotated JPA database persistence entity (@Entity in Task.java). TaskController.addtask exposes Task directly without DTO encapsulation, leaking internal database structure and enabling over-posting mass assignment. Verified True Positive (TP).
findings.reviewerNotes: Detected following cross-file JPA entity resolution. Automated remediation deferred to multi-file refactoring planner.
